details.summary: Swedish Foreign Minister and third Director General of the International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA) 1981-1997
details.life: Was born in Uppsala, Sweden on 28 June 1928. He is the son of Gunnar Blix, professor of medicine, and Hertha Wiberg, nurse. On 17 March 1962 he married Eva Margareta Kettis, later Swedish diplomat and Ambassador for Arctic and Antarctic Affairs, with whom he has two sons.
